Dear partner,

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.body:

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery EXW.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your feedback regarding our delivery performance and have incorporated a price reduction accordingly.

Any further step needs approval from our management.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and Lieferzeit 35 days: €15.70 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
